dsconfig.yaml:
# Canary DS
# v102

phonemes: dsacoustic/phonemes.txt
acoustic: dsacoustic/acoustic.onnx
dictionary: dsacoustic/dictionary.txt
vocoder: refinegan

hidden_size: 256

use_key_shift_embed: true
use_speed_embed: true
use_energy_embed: false
use_breathiness_embed: false
use_voicing_embed: false
use_tension_embed: false
use_continuous_acceleration: true
use_variable_depth: true

max_depth: 0.6
num_mel_bins: 128
mel_fmin: 40
mel_fmax: 16000
mel_base: '10'
mel_scale: slaney

speakers:
  - dsacoustic/canary_arc
  - dsacoustic/canary_spark
  - dsacoustic/canary_voltage

augmentation_args:
  random_pitch_shifting:
    enabled: true
    range: [-5., 5.]
    scale: 1.0
  fixed_pitch_shifting:
    enabled: true
    targets: [-5., 5.]
    scale: 0.75
  random_time_stretching:
    enabled: true
    range: [0.5, 2.]
    domain: log  # or linear
    scale: 1.0
dsdur/dsconfig.yaml:
# ver b08
phonemes: files/phonemes.txt
linguistic: files/linguistic.onnx
dur: files/dur.onnx

hop_size: 512
sample_rate: 44100

predict_dur: true
predict_pitch: false
use_expr: true
use_note_rest: true
use_continuous_acceleration: true

speakers:
  - files/canary_arc
  - files/canary_spark
  - files/canary_voltage
dspitch/dsconfig.yaml:
# ver b08
phonemes: files/phonemes.txt
linguistic: files/linguistic.onnx
pitch: files/pitch.onnx

hop_size: 512
sample_rate: 44100

# for melody encoder
predict_dur: false
use_note_rest: true
use_expr: true
use_continuous_acceleration: true

speakers:
  - files/canary
